notes_extra: 68 Berger. .025 jump, which is not COAL. 1-14 Lilja, Rem 700. The catalog has only this 68 gr Berger.

author: fdshuster
notes_extra: Berger 68 gr. #24411. Seated to touch. A little on the mild side. His Sep 20, 2011 post states the same 30 gr of N133 and wrote 205/205M. He prefers Federal 205 and saw no advantage with 205M. The 80 gr Berger #24321 at 31.5 gr of Varget in the same post is a different bullet.

author: fdshuster
notes_extra: Same 68 gr. Berger #24411. A little better at 300 yards or in wind. Seated to touch. He prefers Federal 205.
